angles: Treat final selection as a forecasting problem with a labelled track record: the idea library across runs already holds past finalists and (where run) their blinded benchmark verdicts, so the internal judge can be scored and recalibrated against held-out external outcomes (e.g. fit a Bradley-Terry correction or reweight critic features to predict rater/outcome wins), attacking the stage where a lone agent is weakest, namely choosing its own top 3 without any feedback on its own selection error.

Replace argument with manufactured evidence: before the pairwise finals, each surviving idea's single load-bearing claim is converted into a cheap, falsifiable check run in the sandbox (Fermi estimate with stated inputs, toy simulation, minimal prototype, or a counterexample search), and the finals judge sees the check results rather than the prose, so ranking moves from persuasiveness to survived tests, something a single agent self-selecting from 20 ideas never does.

domains.text: Germinal-centre affinity maturation in immunology: B-cell clones undergo somatic hypermutation, compete for limited antigen and T-follicular-helper signals, and expand in proportion to binding affinity over repeated cycles, with explicit rounds of dark-zone mutation and light-zone selection and a mechanism that retains memory cells from earlier cycles.

Multi-environment crop variety trials in plant breeding: candidate lines are grown across deliberately varied sites and seasons, genotype-by-environment interaction is modelled explicitly, and varieties are released for stability across environments (e.g. Finlay-Wilkinson regression, AMMI) rather than for peak yield at one trial plot.
